trips.name: Spokane International
trips.note: Spokane International No. 1, Yahk to Spokane, daily. It leaves Yahk ten minutes after No. 11 arrives from Lethbridge and Cranbrook, and stands twenty minutes at the border.

trips.name: Spokane International
trips.note: Spokane International No. 2, Spokane to Yahk, daily, leaving Spokane at 11.59 the night before. At Yahk it connects with the mixed train to Cranbrook and with No. 11 for Nelson and Vancouver.
